title: Fabledom
shortDescription: Set in a wholesome fairytale world, Fabledom is a laid-back City builder. Enjoy the growth of your settlement, interact with your neighbors and defend your kingdom from magical creatures. All to find true love and live happily ever after!
zhShortDescription: 温馨童话风格的城市建造游戏，建造王国、发展外交。
description: Welcome, your Highness! A vast land awaits your settlers and is ready to be colonized. Fabledom offers an accessible and intuitive way of playing City builders, the game is easy to pick up and play for anyone but can still offer a challenge for more experienced players thanks to its difficulty settings. Set in a strange world where Fairytales become reality, you will witness the growth of your village; follow your citizens’ lives and watch the rise and fall of your relationships with the neighboring kingdoms. From a small village to a bustling Fairy tale Kingdom Find the promised land, settle, and flourish! You will need every resource available to you to expand and thrive. zhDescription: 《Fabledom》是一款温馨童话风格的城市建造游戏。在奇幻世界中建造城堡、发展村庄、管理资源。独特的恋爱系统让你可以与其他统治者建立关系。
metaDescriptionEn: Fabledom review — fairy-tale city builder with diplomacy. Resource management, kingdom growth, romance.
metaDescriptionZh: 《寓言之地》Steam 评测与介绍 — 童话风城市建造游戏。资源管理、外交策略、王国发展。

topReviews.review:
I'm not really sure I'd call this "laid-back" as the blurb seems to claim. As pretty as it is to look at, it's pretty shallow, while also being really tedious later on.

Resource gathering/generation seems to be super unbalanced and doesn't really make much sense. After a few hours of gameplay I had almost 2000 Iron from only 2 Iron Mines, yet nothing to really use it on, while I had 6 Charcoal Kilns going, yet my stock was continually stuck on 0 or 1, with my villagers complaining they had no heat during winter. I didn't have any Armaments or anything crafting either, so I have no clue where …
topReviews.zh_review: 我不太确定能管它叫'轻松休闲'。画面很美，但内容挺浅的，后期还特别繁琐。资源采集/产出严重失衡——玩了几个小时后我两个铁矿就有近2000铁却没处用，同时6个炭窑全天运转、库存永远0或1，居民一直抱怨冬天没取暖。我什么都没在造，根本不知道所有资源去哪了。

topReviews.review: I like this game....for the whimsy and cuteness, but I finished the game in less than 12 hours. You do get a few hours of gameplay, but it is not in-depth enough during the end game. Just repetition later down the line. Would buy it on sale at $6.29 for a few hours of gaming, but would not pay $20.99 for a lackluster game. 2.5/5.
topReviews.zh_review: 我喜欢这游戏的奇幻可爱风格，但不到12小时就通关了。确实有几小时的乐趣，但终局不够深入，后期就是重复。打折$6.29时买来玩几小时还行，但不值$20.99。2.5/5。

whyPlay: Fabledom is a city-builder that prioritizes charm over complexity. It's fairy-tale kingdom building with romance and diplomacy, wrapped in storybook visuals. The systems aren't as deep as Anno or Foundation, but that's the point — it's a gentler entry point for players who find traditional city-builders intimidating. Play it for the vibes, stay for the prince/princess romances.
whyPlayZh: 《寓言之地》是一款把魅力放在复杂度之前的城市建造游戏。童话王国建设加上恋爱和外交，包裹在绘本般的视觉里。系统不如纪元或 Foundation 深，但这正是重点——它是为觉得传统城市建造太难的玩家准备的温和入口。为氛围而来，为王子的浪漫留下。
